newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cegetel wins La Defense telecom licence.
newsitem.headline: Cegetel wins La Defense telecom licence.

text.p: Cegetel has been awarded an experimental licence to set up a telecommunications network in the La Defense business district on the Paris outskirts, the Post, Telecommunications and Space Minister said on Tuesday.
Cegetel, a joint venture of utilities group Generale des Eaux, will offer a wide range of high-speed telecommunications, the ministry said in a statement.
This is the seventh licence to be awarded for experimental services since a 1996 law on information technologies and is the first to have been granted by the new French telecoms regulator ART.
Cegetel partners include British Telecommunications Plc, Mannesmann AG and SBC Communications.
